summary: A Depth subscription: the 166-byte snapquote gives the best five each side and the day's figures; it has no LTP, so both sides publish its average trade price as ltp; an empty book is five zero levels each side on both.

notes: Average as LTP is inherited from the web (audit inherited limitation 1): both publish 1498.76 here, pinned as it is.
A Depth subscriber gets the book frame only; the desktop's frame takes its quote fields from the snapquote's own tick.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends Pocketful's change key from LTP up (names.rs `from`), in Quote and Depth frames too; the Pocketful web adapter sends change only in its LTP (compact) frame. Open until wire's WebName.to.

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).
